correctness.rationale: Direct definition with universal gap-and-colour extensions gives the displayed finite min-gap recurrence. Induction: for each colour choose a pivot whose left/right ranks are at least t; leftmost/rightmost pivots support two E_t subsequences with a central permutation, proving necessity, and those central positions prove sufficiency. Unique fixed-length decomposition implies N_t=q(2^t-1) and |E_t|=(q!)^(2^t-1). Exhaustive independent marked-subset game recursion on 2,127 words, embedding criterion on 69,029 cases, full extremal enumerations and 180 longer witnesses all passed. Enumeration only corroborates finite cases; the proof carries arbitrary q,t,n.

value.rationale: The natural Fraïssé expansion of finite chains by q named unary colours requires all q insertion types at every marked gap, so the uncoloured cardinality formula is insufficient. This theorem identifies the exact induced-subword basis of each rank threshold, all-size sharp host size, and exact exponentially growing family of minimal nonisomorphic hosts. The complete relative-rank gap recurrence and O(n^3+qn^2) constructive evaluation give mathematically useful structural tools beyond a routine substitution.
